200.description:
Addresses (structures and address points) or roads whose provider-maintained DateUpdate is later than `since`, as `DateUpdate > DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD'` (or `> TIMESTAMP` for a date-time), in keyset pages pinned to the layer's dataLastEditDate like records_list, optionally restricted to one county. Deletions are not reported (the publisher keeps no changelog). Parcels, easements, public lands and boundaries have no modified-since field, so they are not offered here: diff snapshots from records_list instead.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attributes` | object | The layer's attribute fields, named exactly as the source names them (see README for the per-layer field lists); esriFieldTypeDate values are RFC 3339 UTC strings, Shape__* fields are dropped and, for parcels, the MCA 2-6-1017 owner fields are moved to `owner`. |
| `global_id` | string |  |
| `id_field` | string | Which source field `source_record_id` came from. |
| `object_id` | number | ArcGIS OBJECTID at publication time; reassigned on every reload, so only valid together with publication_id. |
| `owner` | object | Parcels only. The Department of Revenue owner fields, tagged with the MCA 2-6-1017 notice; null when the call set exclude_owner. Absent on other layers. |
| `publication_id` | string | `<layer>:<editingInfo.dataLastEditDate epoch ms>` of the layer the record was read from. |
| `retrieved_at` | string | RFC 3339 UTC time of the read. |
| `source_record_id` | string | The publisher's own id: PARCELID (parcels; `globalid:<uuid>` when the DOR geocode is null), NGUID (addresses, roads), UniqueID (conservation easements), GlobalID (public lands, boundaries). |
| `source_url` | string | FeatureServer query URL that returns this record by its id. |

200.description:
The current records of one layer, in 2,000-row pages (1,000 for addresses) ordered by OBJECTID with a keyset cursor (`OBJECTID > last`) pinned to the layer's editingInfo.dataLastEditDate. Every page re-reads the layer document and fails with invalid_input / `publication_changed` when the pin moved, so pages from two publications are never mixed. parcels, addresses and roads are segmented by county (segment key: CountyName / County / County_L); conservation_easements, public_lands and boundaries:<id> list statewide. Attribute-only (no geometry). Every record carries source_record_id, source_url, publication_id and retrieved_at; parcel owner fields are grouped under `owner` with the MCA 2-6-1017 notice and can be excluded.

post.description: Start here to learn whether a layer moved since the last collection and to get the publication id that records_list pins; or to hand off a bulk file URL.

county.description: parcels only: one of the 56 Montana counties, as the CountyName value ('Lewis and Clark') or the bulk folder name ('LewisClark'). Selects the county's monthly parcel publication files and counts its parcels; without it the statewide files and count are returned. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]*$.

layer.description: parcels | public_lands | conservation_easements | addresses | roads | boundaries:<FeatureServer layer id, e.g. boundaries:5 for county boundaries> | land_cover | hydrography. Pattern: ^(parcels|public_lands|conservation_easements|addresses|roads|land_cover|hydrography|boundaries:[0-9]{1,3})$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Cheap version check for one MSDI layer: the ArcGIS layer's publication pin (editingInfo.dataLastEditDate as publication_id and published_at), maxRecordCount, the returnCountOnly record count (for parcels optionally one county), and the bulk publication files on ftpgeoinfo.msl.mt.gov from the theme folder's IIS listing with HEAD Content-Length, Last-Modified and ETag (the publisher posts no hashes; the ETag is the file's version). Layers: parcels, public_lands, conservation_easements, addresses, roads, boundaries:<layer id>, and the status-only land_cover and hydrography. Most files exceed the 32 MiB runner cap, so this is the hand-off: URL, size and ETag.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `county` | string | Normalised CountyName when `county` was given. |
| `files` | object[] |  |
| `layer` | string |  |
| `layer_name` | string | FeatureServer layer name, or the MSDI theme for status-only layers. |
| `max_record_count` | number | Rows per query page the layer allows. |
| `notice` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `publication_id` | string | `<layer>:<dataLastEditDate ms>` for ArcGIS layers; `<layer>:<newest file Last-Modified ms>` for status-only layers. |
| `published_at` | string | RFC 3339 UTC of the publication pin. |
| `record_count` | number | returnCountOnly for the layer (or the county's parcels); null for status-only layers. |
| `service_url` | string | FeatureServer layer URL; null for land_cover and hydrography (no record surface). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
